WITH RECURSIVE
                thread (
                    message_id,
                    parent_message_id,
                    member_name,
                    text,
                    media_kind,
                    media_file_id,
                    depth
                ) AS (
                    SELECT
                        message_id,
                        parent_message_id,
                        member_name,
                        text,
                        media_kind,
                        media_file_id,
                        1
                    FROM
                        reply_messages
                    WHERE
                        chat_id = ?1
                        AND message_id = ?2
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT
                        parent.message_id,
                        parent.parent_message_id,
                        parent.member_name,
                        parent.text,
                        parent.media_kind,
                        parent.media_file_id,
                        thread.depth + 1
                    FROM
                        reply_messages AS parent
                        INNER JOIN thread ON parent.message_id = thread.parent_message_id
                    WHERE
                        parent.chat_id = ?1
                        AND thread.depth < ?3
                )
            SELECT
                member_name AS "member_name?: String",
                text AS "text?: String",
                media_kind AS "media_kind?: String",
                media_file_id AS "media_file_id?: String"
            FROM
                thread
            ORDER BY
                depth DESC
